question: As of 10 April 2022, how many general elections have been held to the Lok Sabha?
solution: As of 10 April 2022, a total of 17 general elections have been held to the Lok Sabha. This information is important for understanding the history and political landscape of India, as well as for researchers and journalists who may need accurate data on past elections.
